message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ["*"]
  push:
    branches: ["master"]

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and Test
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        scala: [2.12.20, 2.13.16, 3.3.6]
        java: [17, 21]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Container modules occupy too much disk space. The GitHub-hosted runners ran into the
      # error: "no space left on device."
      # This action will free up disk space by removing unnecessary files.
      - name: Free Disk Space
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@v1.3.1
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        with:
          tool-cache: true
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: true
          docker-images: true
          swap-storage: false

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin # See 'Supported distributions' for available options
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          check-latest: true
          cache: "sbt"

      - name: Setup sbt launcher
        uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1

      - run: sbt ++${{ matrix.scala }} test
",
  "rationale": "The workflow currently has no job-level timeout, relying on the GitHub Actions default of 6 hours. Historical runs show successful executions complete in ~14 minutes. Adding a custom timeout of 30 minutes (2x headroom) bounds runaway jobs while preserving all matrix combinations and test coverage. This optimization is directly supported by experiment evidence (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) demonstrating elapsed time savings when a timeout is introduced, and the pattern catalogue confirms the mechanism with estimated VM time reductions. The change is minimal, does not alter permissions or required checks, and maintains the existing build/test matrix.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508",
    "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"
  ]
}

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ["*"]
  push:
    branches: ["master"]

  build:

        java: [17, 21]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:

          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: true
          docker-images: true
          swap-storage: false

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin # See 'Supported distributions' for available options
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          check-latest: true
          cache: "sbt"

      - name: Setup sbt launcher
